title: GraphCast-Mamba: Learning Non-Markovian Corrections for Weather Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.28512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unresolved atmospheric processes can introduce history dependence beyond the short input windows used by many weather forecasting models. We introduce GraphCast--Mamba, which augments a frozen, pretrained $1^\circ$ GraphCast backbone with a trainable Mamba correction branch combining graph message passing and Mamba layers. The branch retains a temporal memory state across successive six-hour forecast steps, learning corrections informed by temporal context beyond GraphCast's two-frame input. Training is confined to the correction branch, using ERA5 data from 2015--2021. After 2,500 optimizer updates, including warm-up, the selected model achieves substantial improvements relative to the uncorrected GraphCast backbone. It reduces the GraphCast loss (normalized weighted mean-squared error; MSE) by 14.42% when aggregated over the full ten-day forecast and by 21.66% at day 10 (240 h after forecast initialization). translated_title: GraphCast-Mamba：学习天气预报的非马尔可夫修正
translated_abstract: 未被解析的大气过程可能会引入超出许多天气预报模型所使用的短输入窗口的历史依赖性。我们提出了GraphCast-Mamba，它在冻结的预训练1°分辨率GraphCast主干网络上增加了一个可训练的Mamba修正分支，该分支结合了图消息传递和Mamba层。该分支在连续的六小时预报步骤之间保留时间记忆状态，学习基于超出GraphCast两帧输入的时间上下文的修正。训练仅限于修正分支，使用2015至2021年的ERA5数据。经过包括预热在内的2500次优化器更新后，所选模型相对于未经修正的GraphCast主干网络取得了显著改进。在整个十天预报的汇总中，该模型将GraphCast损失（归一化加权均方误差，MSE）降低了14.42%，在第10天（预报初始化后240小时）降低了21.66%。在这一最终预报时效上……
tldr: GraphCast-Mamba在冻结的GraphCast主干网络上加入结合图消息传递与Mamba层的可训练修正分支，通过跨预报步骤的时间记忆学习超出两帧输入的非马尔可夫修正，使十天预报整体损失降低14.42%，第10天损失降低21.66%。
en_tdlr: GraphCast-Mamba augments a frozen GraphCast backbone with a trainable Mamba correction branch that retains temporal memory across successive six-hour forecast steps, learning non-Markovian corrections beyond the two-frame input that reduce the ten-day forecast loss by 14.42% overall and by 21.66% at day 10.
